title: UPDATE: Liquid AI Releases 2 Open Weight Decision Models with Nvidia
summary:
Liquid AI has launched Open d1, a family of multimodal decision models that can be run on NVIDIA DGX data centers, RTX workstations, and Jetson edge devices. The release consists of two open-weight models: d1-3B, which supports text and vision, and an experimental d1-omni-600M, a 600M parameter model capable of processing text combined with audio or images. The models are designed for real-time, on-device applications, including voice-command routing, on-device moderation, and gesture-controlled games.

The open-weight launch expands on earlier performance data showing that d1 matches or beats GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5 on 4 of 6 real-world applications. The model utilizes a single forward pass to provide decisions in 200 to 300 ms without generating tokens, which reduces operating costs by 19x to 200x compared to the competitors. For industrial applications, the model achieves 85% to 97% accuracy on VisA inspection tasks.

d1-omni-600M is an experimental 600M-parameter model for text + image or text + audio.

It combines LFM2.5-Encoder-350M with vision and audio encoders, and leads our text benchmark comparison in toxicity detection and paraphrase identification.

Use it for voice-command routing, on-device moderation, and intent classification.
